description.value:
This is the ideal superheavy machine pistol for mercs on a budget. The Auto-Slugger’s brutish frame and heavy rounds aren’t user friendly, accurate, and certainly not pretty when they paint a wall with meat-chunks. Still, quite a few mercs swear by these. Mostly Nomads that need a heavy, low-cost one-hander and mercs that need to say ‘leave me the fuck alone’ to anyone who spots this in their holster. If you really want to make the most of this beast, consider cybernetics and a muzzle compensator. Or just spray ‘n pray, if you’re desperate.

Cost: 500eb (Expensive)

Class: Heavy SMG • Skill: Handgun • Range: Subcompact SMG

Damage: 4d6 • Capacity: 15 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (Machine Pistol 4), Suppressive Fire

Concealable: No

Slots: 3 • Attachments: Sling • Mods: None

Special Features: Using Autofire with this weapon expends 5 rounds instead of 10. All ammunition fired from this weapon also functions as Explosive Ammunition, including its -2 Attack Check penalty and inability to make Aimed Shots. When fired in Autofire by a user without a Cyberarm or BODY 11+, they suffer the Crushed Fingers Critical Injury if they didn’t have it already.

Range: Subcompact SMG
Pre-installed: Sling (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (Machine Pistol 4), Suppressive Fire

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
